description: Use this when the user asks how the business is doing: invoiced and collected this month, outstanding and overdue amounts, recent invoices or approvals waiting. The business dashboard's figures: per currency this month's invoiced total; paid (all-time total of fully paid invoices); collected_this_month (money received this calendar month in Dubai time, by payment date: part payments included, bank charges left out, refunds subtracted, so it can be negative); outstanding, overdue count and amount; total invoice count; the most overdue invoices; the newest invoices; and documents waiting for approval. Do not use it for profit (get_profit_and_loss) or for what to pay or file next (get_whats_due).

business_id.description: From list_businesses. May be left out when the connection shares exactly one business.
